label: Divine DOXASTIC_BELIEF_1 is calibrated to DOXASTIC_BELIEF_2 by fixed contents
paraphrase: OPEN calibration. For each GOD_4 with classical attributes, each legacy actual assent has a content assented under the supplied assent relation, with the same fixed report, such that truth of that content at actuality implies its report. Each content the bearer assents to under that relation is believed under the supplied Kripke box at actuality. The interpretation, report, and assent to individuated contents are held fixed within one application. No record pins them to an independently interpreted content theory, and the type does not make the assent relation independent of the legacy assent. For a fixed context with actual access, some content type, interpretation, report and assent relation satisfy the calibration exactly when 7dd8a624 holds (Lean fixedContentRepresentationIff, #2103: Prop contents true at a world exactly when they hold, the identity report, and assent identified with the legacy assent). With these parameters unpinned the calibration re-presents 7dd8a624, and the DOXASTIC_BELIEF_1 to DOXASTIC_BELIEF_2 bridge carries no warrant beyond it.
